scripts.title: Mod Menu
scripts.features:
[+] Mod Menu v1.6.0 for 3008 - Feature List

⭐ MAIN FEATURES:
• Speed Slider (16 - 120) - Custom walk speed modifier.
• Jump Power Slider (40 - 150) - Custom jump height/force modifier.
• Fake Watch - Grants the gamepass progression clock UI for free.
• Fake Nickname - Locally changes your topbar username to any custom text.

👁️ VISUALS:
• Player & NPC ESP - Highlights real players (Blue) and mutant employees (Red) through solid walls.
• FullBright (Headlight) - Attaches a powerful spotlight to your character's head to see perfectly in the dark.

⚙️ OTHER & UTILITIES:
• Infinite Admin - Instantly loads the full Infinite Yield admin command panel.
• Trans Walk - Forces transparent parts to maintain proper collision boundaries.
• Anti-Fall - Detects freefall and stops you from instantly dying/losing your items in the void.

🛠️ UI COMFORT:
• Description System [?] - Click the question mark button next to any feature to see an instant description of what it does.
• Clean & Organized Layout - Modern design featuring smooth transitions, a drag system, and minimize/close buttons.
